Reason for referral: Evaluation of perioperative cardiac risk before planned elective
total knee replacement.

LIPID PANEL

LDL Cholesterol: 138 mg/dL (H)
HDL Cholesterol: 45 mg/dL

BASIC METABOLIC PANEL
Sodium: 137 mmol/L
Potassium: 3.8 mmol/L
Chloride: 101 mmol/L
CO2: 27 mmol/L
BUN: 28 mg/dL (H)
Creatininc: 0.7 mg/dL
Glucose: 175 mg/dL (H)
Calcium: 10.1 mg/dL

Amlodipine 5 mg by mouth once daily
Losartan 50 mg by mouth once daily
Metformin 500 mg by mouth twice daily
Acetaminophen 500 mg by mouth as needed

EXAM:
General: well appearing, no distress.
Neck: no carotid bruits.
Cardiac exam: regular rate and rhythm, normal S1 and S2, soft systoIic murmur at the
sternal border, no gallop.
Lungs: clear to auscultation bilaterally.
Extremities: 1+ pitting edema of both ankles.
